title: Kira Kepala, Faiz!
genre: Malay musical-theatre showtune (teater muzikal ensemble number)
subject: a young Malaysian tour guide counting heads on the Great Wall at Badaling on a packed October holiday-week day, with twenty-eight mak ciks from Tanjung Karang in matching purple tudung, one pulled into a Henan family's holiday photos, one reaching the North Eighth Tower alone ahead of everyone, one demanding her climbing certificate say 'srikandi' instead of 'hero', and the count always one short
caption: Malay musical-theatre showtune, a comic ensemble number in the Broadway style of a 2020s Kuala Lumpur stage musical. A bright pit orchestra: a busy stride-and-vamp piano, pizzicato strings that open into sweeping violins, a muted trumpet firing comic stabs between the lines, a glockenspiel twinkling over the top, and a brushed snare with cymbal hits on the punchlines. Clean theatrical mix with a wide stage feel, voices up front. Male lead tenor, clear and theatrical, patter-singing the verses as a harried young tour guide, answered by a female choir of middle-aged women singing in loud, cheerful unison and humming warm harmony under him on the bridge. 132 BPM, Bb major. Comic, bustling and warm-hearted. No pop drum kit, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no EDM, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - pit orchestra fanfare, glockenspiel and pizzicato strings]

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
Dua puluh lapan mak cik dari Tanjung Karang
Tudung ungu sedondon, kasut sukan baru beli
Beg penuh sambal bilis dengan cerek elektrik
Cuti panjang Oktober, Badaling sesak berasak-asak

[Pre-Chorus - Female Choir shouts, Male Vocal answers]
"Faiz, Tembok Besar! Faiz, Tembok Besar!"
"Ya, mak cik, pegang besi, jangan lari!"

[Chorus - Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu, dua puluh lapan, atas Tembok Besar
Satu keluarga dari Henan nak bergambar sekali
Satu, dua, tiga, semua mak cik buat peace
Kira kepala, kurang satu lagi!

[Verse 2 - Male Vocal]
Kira sekali, dua puluh tujuh
Kira lagi, dua puluh enam pula
Mak Cik Bedah kena tarik masuk gambar keluarga Henan
Mak Cik Timah dah sampai menara lapan sorang-sorang

[Chorus - Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu atas Tembok Besar
Mak Cik Senah beli sijil, "Tulis srikandi, bukan hero!"
Mak Cik Timah jerit dari atas, "Faiz, lambat macam siput!"
Kira kepala, kurang dua lagi!

[Bridge - Male Vocal, slow and warm, Female Choir harmony underneath, orchestra hushed]
Angin Oktober, daun merah gugur atas tangga batu
Lutut dah berbunyi, tapi tak ada siapa nak turun dulu

[Chorus - key change up, Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu turun Tembok Besar
Dua puluh lapan, cukup, bas boleh jalan
"Faiz, singgah kejap, nak cari itik Peking halal!"
Kira kepala, kurang satu lagi!

[Outro - orchestra button and a cymbal crash]
